headAttachment.method: Exhaustive exact RGBA matching of standing head region [15,5,33,21] inclusive against each accepted body pose. All 20 poses match without changes, using only the recorded integer translations. Apply the same translations to rigid mask and short hair.

layers.normal: Independent transparent hair pixels only; no anatomy, clothing or mask baked in.
layers.fitted: Alpha-only clipped variant. Kept pixels retain exact colors and positions.

helmetRules.method: Clip only crown/back protrusions to the fitted head envelope. Transparent strap openings reveal 27 male / 32 female hair pixels in each pose. Removing mask restores normal hair. This is one hairstyle/item compatibility fit, not a generic hide-hair rule.

generation.derivatives: Exact extraction, palette mapping and body-specific head translations in PixelLab pixelart_workbench.
